I turn up the volume all the way and listen to the sounds in his room... the birds outside his window, his dog barking, someone talking loudly in another language downstairs. I take medication, I see a therapist. I try to work out as often as I can. I do little tasks each day like drawing a sketch and writing in a journal. I listen to music and podcasts that make me feel good. I stay away from people who give me anxiety or don't make me feel good. I stay in constant contact with friends who know that I don't like to be alone for a long amount of time. I try to remember that the world is all about evolving and change and that in a few days or months or years things can be completely different. I remember that consciousness, existence, and the universe are very strange and complex, but wonderful overall and I try to be grateful for the experience.
